name: payments
description: A payments back office. Refunds require an eligibility check first; payouts are irreversible.

tools.name: search_transactions
tools.description: Search transactions by free-text query, order id, or customer. Read-only. Use to find a transaction when you do not have its exact id.

query.description: Free text, order id, or amount.

customer_id.description: Optional customer to scope the search.

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: Fetch a single transaction by its exact transaction id. Read-only.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Fetch a customer profile by customer id. Read-only.

tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
tools.description: Check whether a transaction can be refunded under policy. This MUST be called and pass before any refund is issued.

tools.name: refund_payment
tools.description: Issue a refund for a transaction. Only call after check_refund_eligibility has confirmed the transaction is eligible. Moves money.

amount.description: Optional partial amount; omit for a full refund.

tools.name: create_payout
tools.description: Send a payout to a recipient. Irreversible. Not a refund; use only for deliberate disbursements.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get the current balance of an account. Read-only.
